name: calendar-mastodon-bot
description: Cloudflare Worker to post calendar events to Mastodon

scripts.whoami:user: unset CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY CLOUDFLARE_EMAIL CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID && CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN=$CLOUDFLARE_SOCIALCOOP wrangler whoami --config wrangler.local.toml
scripts.deploy:user: unset CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY CLOUDFLARE_EMAIL CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID && CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN=$CLOUDFLARE_SOCIALCOOP wrangler deploy --config wrangler.local.toml
